guideTitle: The Best Desk Pad Protectors: PU Leather or Clear PVC
metaTitle: Best Desk Pad Protectors: Leather and Clear Mats (2026)
metaDescription: A desk protector either covers the desk in PU leather or shows it through clear PVC. We compared eight low-cost protectors on material, size, thickness and base.
introParagraphs: A desk protector's job is to take the scratches, spills and heat instead of the desktop. The main choice is how it looks: PU leather covers the surface in black or a color, while clear PVC keeps the desk's own finish visible.

Most of the leather protectors here come from two brands, Aothia and YSAGi, in several listings that differ mainly by size or color, so choose by the size you need and the lowest price for it. Many listings don't give full dimensions; measure your desk and confirm before buying.
All eight cost under $20 at the time of writing. Our comparison is based on listed materials and sizes, not hands-on testing.

best-desk-pad-protectors-1.summary: Aothia's 23.6 x 13.7-inch waterproof PU leather protector with non-slip design.
best-desk-pad-protectors-1.description:
The Aothia is a simple, clearly sized protector: 23.6 x 13.7 inches of waterproof PU leather, described as guarding against scratches, stains, spills, heat and scuffs, with a non-slip design.

That size suits a laptop or compact keyboard and mouse rather than a full desk.
best-desk-pad-protectors-1.skipIf: You need more coverage; the Aothia 15.7-inch-deep version is larger.

best-desk-pad-protectors-2.summary: A YSAGi PU leather protector; confirm size on the listing.
best-desk-pad-protectors-2.description:
The YSAGi Leather Office Desk Pad Protector is a PU leather pad YSAGi says protects against scratches, stains, spills, heat and scuffs.

The listing summary doesn't state size. YSAGi has three listings here with the same description, so compare sizes and colors across them.
best-desk-pad-protectors-2.bestFor: A basic leather protector once size is confirmed.
best-desk-pad-protectors-2.skipIf: You want a stated size; the Aothia lists 23.6 x 13.7 inches.

best-desk-pad-protectors-3.summary: A black 23.6 x 13.7-inch PU leather protector with non-slip design, the cheapest here.
best-desk-pad-protectors-3.description:
This unbranded protector matches the Aothia's 23.6 x 13.7-inch size in black PU leather with a non-slip design, at about $7 at the time of writing, the lowest price here.

The brand isn't named in the listing.
best-desk-pad-protectors-3.skipIf: You prefer a named brand; the Aothia is the same size.

best-desk-pad-protectors-4.summary: Another YSAGi PU leather listing with the same description, at a higher price.
best-desk-pad-protectors-4.description:
This YSAGi listing shares the same description as the other two and cost about $4 more at the time of writing, which likely reflects a larger size or different color.

Confirm what the extra cost buys on the listing.
cons: Costs more than other YSAGi listings
best-desk-pad-protectors-4.bestFor: A specific YSAGi size or color.
best-desk-pad-protectors-4.skipIf: A cheaper YSAGi listing has the size you need.

best-desk-pad-protectors-5.summary: A third YSAGi PU leather protector listing.
best-desk-pad-protectors-5.description:
The third YSAGi listing uses the same description at about $10 at the time of writing.

As with the others, check the size and color it covers before buying.
best-desk-pad-protectors-5.skipIf: You need a stated size; the Aothia or unbranded pad lists one.

best-desk-pad-protectors-6.summary: Aothia's PU leather protector in a 15.7-inch-deep size for laptop, keyboard and mouse.
best-desk-pad-protectors-6.description:
This Aothia listing is a larger version, 15.7 inches deep, which Aothia says fits a laptop, mouse and keyboard.

The full width isn't given in the listing summary; it cost about $4 more than the compact Aothia at the time of writing.
best-desk-pad-protectors-6.skipIf: Your space is compact; the 23.6-inch Aothia costs less.

best-desk-pad-protectors-7.summary: A clear, anti-static PVC desk cover with rounded edges that shows the desk's finish.
best-desk-pad-protectors-7.description:
The LBJFYHJN is a clear PVC mat that protects the desk while keeping its original look visible, with rounded edges and anti-static PVC.

Its size and thickness aren't stated in the listing summary.
best-desk-pad-protectors-7.bestFor: Protecting an attractive wood desk without hiding it.
best-desk-pad-protectors-7.skipIf: You want a stated size and thickness; the LovePads lists both.

best-desk-pad-protectors-8.summary: A 16 x 36-inch clear BPA-free PVC mat available in 1.5mm or 2mm thickness.
best-desk-pad-protectors-8.description:
The LovePads is the better-specified clear option: 16 x 36 inches of BPA-free PVC, offered in 1.5mm or 2mm thickness, suitable for desks and tables.

It was the most expensive protector here at the time of writing, still under $20.
best-desk-pad-protectors-8.bestFor: A clear protector for a standard keyboard area.
best-desk-pad-protectors-8.skipIf: You'd rather hide the desk; a PU leather pad costs less.

buyingCriteria.explanation: PU leather covers the desk; clear PVC shows the finish underneath.
Several listings here don't give full dimensions. Measure your desk and check before buying.
The LovePads offers 1.5mm or 2mm; thicker is generally stiffer.
The Aothia and unbranded pads list non-slip designs.

faq.a: Leather covers the desk; clear PVC shows the finish. Both wipe clean.
Measure the area you want protected, usually keyboard, mouse and writing space.

faq.q: Why are there several YSAGi listings?
faq.a: They share a description and likely differ in size or color. Compare them and buy the one that fits.
For clear mats, thicker PVC is generally stiffer and lies flatter.

faq.q: Will a clear mat stick to the desk?
faq.a: Some PVC can cling to certain finishes; check the manufacturer's guidance for your desk surface.

bottomLine: For a leather-look protector, the Aothia range and the unbranded 23.6-inch pad are the most clearly sized low-cost options. For a clear protector, the LovePads specifies size and thickness.
The three YSAGi listings are essentially one product in different variants; choose whichever size fits for the least.
